newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's most eligible bachelor ties the knot.
newsitem.headline: Italy's most eligible bachelor ties the knot.

text.p: Italy lost its most eligible bachelor on Saturday as Giovanni Alberto Agnelli, of the Fiat dynasty, tied the knot in an exclusive wedding under tight security attended by only 30 guests, Italian media reported.

Agnelli, nephew and appointed heir of former Fiat chairman Gianni Agnelli, married British-American architect Avery Howe in the family's chapel in their 16th-century villa near the Tuscan town of Pisa, the reports said.
The wedding was celebrated by Pisa's archbishop Alessandro Plotti.
Only 30 guests, including Agnelli's father Umberto and uncle Gianni, were invited to the exclusive affair which was held under tight security.
The 32-year-old Agnelli, who is chief execuitve of Piaggio scooter-maker, met the blonde Howe, 31, when they were students at Brown University in the United States.
